statement: Write from(i)=edges[i][0], to(i)=edges[i][1], wt(i)=edges[i][2]. Whenever the function returns a result r, define Feas to be the set of all subsets S of {0,...,len(edges)-1} such that dest is reachable from src1 using only edges with indices in S and dest is reachable from src2 using only edges with indices in S. A path from a to b using S is a sequence v0,...,vk with k>=1, v0=a, vk=b, and for each j<k an edge index e_j in S with from(e_j)=v_j and to(e_j)=v_{j+1}. If Feas is empty then r = -1. If Feas is nonempty then r is the minimum of sum_{i in S} wt(i) over S in Feas: there exists S0 in Feas with sum_{i in S0} wt(i)=r, and for every S in Feas, r <= sum_{i in S} wt(i).
